title: Light Green Account at a glance
summary: This card describes the Light Green Account: $0.00 monthly maintenance fee, 0.05% APY, $300 daily spending limit, and $150 daily ATM withdrawal limit. It includes 4 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals/month (then $1.50 fee), $500 daily mobile check deposit limit, and early direct deposit of 0 days before payday; no overdraft fees apply.
